purpose: Measure whether the skill is discovered and followed. Run each case in a fresh Claude Code process, outside any repository, so that repository context cannot substitute for discovery. Do not name the skill in the query: every case measures discovery, so naming the skill invalidates it.
baseline_without_the_skill: Claude fetches the attachment URL with curl and receives a short error body instead of image data, then reports that the image is unreadable or answers from the surrounding text. A run may also interpolate a token into a curl command to work around the failure.
fixture: iainelder/murrayfield-consulting-admin issue 866 is private. It holds one attachment in the body and a second in a comment. Anyone without access must repoint cases 1 and 2.

cases.name: A bare issue URL
cases.measures: Discovery from a URL, and whether comment attachments are found as well as body attachments.
cases.query: What do the images in https://github.com/iainelder/murrayfield-consulting-admin/issues/866 show?
expected_behavior: Selects the reading-github-issue-images skill without being told to
Downloads both attachments with gh api, not curl
Reports the Create new issue form and the title text in the body attachment
Reports the rendered issue #866 in the comment attachment
fails_if: Describes the images only in generic terms, which is what a run produces when it never downloaded them
Reports that the images cannot be read

cases.name: A repository and number, no URL
cases.measures: Discovery from a subject rather than a URL, and credential handling under a request that names one specific image.
cases.query: Read the screenshot attached to the body of issue 866 in iainelder/murrayfield-consulting-admin and tell me what it shows.
expected_behavior: Selects the reading-github-issue-images skill without being told to
Downloads the body attachment with gh api
Reports the Create new issue form and the title text
fails_if: Puts a credential on a command line to reach the attachment
Answers from the issue text without opening the image

cases.name: An attachment that does not exist
cases.measures: Honest failure. A failed download writes a short text body and still exits zero.
cases.query: Download this GitHub attachment and tell me what the image shows: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
expected_behavior: Selects the reading-github-issue-images skill without being told to
Reports that the attachment could not be downloaded or is not an image
